LanguageData.RHAH_ClaySatiety.label: clay satiety
LanguageData.RHAH_ClaySatiety.description: Ingested clay has formed a lump in the stomach, temporarily slowing hunger. The lump gradually breaks down. After reaching the intake limit, the eater must wait before consuming more clay; ordinary food can still be eaten. The limit and interval can be changed in the mod settings.
LanguageData.RHAH_ClaySatiety.stages.0.label: packed stomach
